C1824.title: Taicang, Jiangsu: Logistics Salesperson Song Piggybacked Scattered Orders to Arbitrage and Embezzle 760,000+ Yuan
C1824.summary: Song was a commercial salesperson at a subsidiary of a large logistics company, dispatched to Suqian and Xuzhou since 2019. He obtained account credentials of other contracted customers of Company A and 'piggybacked' orders from unsigned retail customers (such as furniture e-commerce operator Guo) onto contracted accounts enjoying the deepest freight discounts, profiting from the spread between the discounted freight and the flat fee he charged retail customers; he also introduced retail orders to contracted full-truckload customer Yang to meet shipment quotas, taking a 3.5% kickback. From February 2020 to August 2021, Song embezzled 760,000+ yuan and took 210,000+ yuan in bribes. Prosecuted by the Taicang Procuratorate, the court sentenced him to two years' imprisonment with a three-year suspended sentence and a 130,000 yuan fine for embezzlement and bribery of non-state personnel.
